# IfReturnReturnSimplification

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `IfReturnReturnSimplificationInspection`

An `if` whose only job is to return `true` in one branch and `false` in the
other is a long-winded way of returning the condition itself (or its
negation). Return the expression directly.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,10,16,21,36} [Before]
<?php
function isAdult(int $age): bool {
    if ($age >= 18) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

function isBlank(string $s): bool {
    if (($s === '')) { return FALSE; }
    // fallthrough
    return TRUE;
}

function hasBoth($m, $n) {
    if ($m && $n) { return false; }
    else { return true; }
}

function notWidget($w) {
    if ($w instanceof Widget) {
        return false;
    } else {
        return true;
    }
}

function guarded($q) {
    if ($q === null) { log_it(); return true; }
    if ($q > 9) { return true; }
    return false;
}

function guardedElse($q) {
    if ($q === null) { return true; }
    if ($q < 3) { return true; }
    else { return false; }
}

function notBinary($q) {
    if (is_int($q)) { return true; }
    return false;
}

function unbraced($q) {
    if ($q > 1) return true;
    return false;
}

function sameValue($q) {
    if ($q > 1) { return false; }
    return false;
}

function hasElseif($q) {
    if ($q > 1) { return true; }
    elseif ($q < 0) { return true; }
    else { return false; }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function isAdult(int $age): bool {
    return $age >= 18;
}

function isBlank(string $s): bool {
    return $s !== '';
}

function hasBoth($m, $n) {
    return !($m && $n);
}

function notWidget($w) {
    return !($w instanceof Widget);
}

function guarded($q) {
    if ($q === null) { log_it(); return true; }
    if ($q > 9) { return true; }
    return false;
}

function guardedElse($q) {
    if ($q === null) { return true; }
    return $q < 3;
}

function notBinary($q) {
    if (is_int($q)) { return true; }
    return false;
}

function unbraced($q) {
    if ($q > 1) return true;
    return false;
}

function sameValue($q) {
    if ($q > 1) { return false; }
    return false;
}

function hasElseif($q) {
    if ($q > 1) { return true; }
    elseif ($q < 0) { return true; }
    else { return false; }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Return the condition directly: &#39;return $age &gt;= 18&#39;.</li>
<li>line 10: Return the condition directly: &#39;return $s !== &#39;&#39;&#39;.</li>
<li>line 16: Return the condition directly: &#39;return !($m &amp;&amp; $n)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 21: Return the condition directly: &#39;return !($w instanceof Widget)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 36: Return the condition directly: &#39;return $q &lt; 3&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "IfReturnReturnSimplification": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore IfReturnReturnSimplification

/**
 * @noinspection IfReturnReturnSimplificationInspection
 */
```
